title: Compatibility guardrails and customer upgrade sprint: model-tag retirement & SDK shim launch
creator: Asha Nair
description: Build and run a coordinated, time-boxed upgrade sprint to retire legacy model tags and introduce compatibility guardrails (SDK shim + compatibility tester) so customers can migrate with predictable behavior. Deliverables: compatibility matrix, automated compatibility tester runner, SDK shim with deprecation warnings, staged release notes templates, and a cross-functional migration playbook for Support/Sales/Customer Success.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility matrix published and reviewed by eng/design/legal
SDK shim v1 released with opt-in flag and emits structured deprecation warnings
Automated compatibility tester validates top 50 customer request patterns and reports regressions
Release notes and migration guide published in docs and linked from console banners
Customer migration cohort (pilot) completes upgrades without Sev1 regressions
rollout_timeline: 2026-03-17: Compat matrix draft (model variants x API behaviors) ready for review
2026-03-24: SDK shim alpha published (internal) + automated tester prototype
2026-03-31: Pilot invites to 8 customers; Support runbook and playbook rehearsed
2026-04-07: Public SDK shim release candidate; docs & release notes draft completed
2026-04-14: Gradual public rollout with console banners and migration cohort expansion
2026-04-15: Targeted milestone: 80% pilot migrated or on migration plan
communication_plan: Internal: biweekly cross-functional sync and daily Slack channel (#pm-compat-rollout)
External: staged email cadence (pilot -> early adopters -> general) with migration checklist
Console: contextual banner linking to migration guide and 'test migration' sandbox
Release notes: consolidated changelog + per-model known-compatibility table
Sales enablement: one-pager and FAQ for field reps and AE playbook

ENG: implement SDK shim with deprecation header & telemetry - owner: Priya Shah (ENG-4820)

risks: Undetected behavior regressions in corner-case prompt patterns causing customer breakage
Late discovery of incompatible public SDK usage patterns (increasing migration cost)
Insufficient telemetry to triage migration failures quickly
Legal / compliance flags for deprecation notices in regulated customers delaying comms
mitigations: Prioritize automated tester coverage for high-volume customer patterns and add sampling for long-tail requests
Introduce opt-in compatibility mode for 30 days to let customers validate before enforced migration
Add structured telemetry events (compat_check, shim_warning, shim_block) and SLOs for triage latency
Pre-clear communication templates with Legal and Privacy during week 1
notes: Goal is predictable customer experience not aggressive removal: aim for 8-week public runway from RC to enforcement
We will provide a migration lab environment with sandboxed keys for customers to run compatibility tests
Consider offering sales-assisted migration for top 10 customers as a white-glove service

2026-03-13: Decision: adopt staged opt-in period (30 days) before enforcement. PM to update release notes draft and coordinate messaging with Legal.
